create_augmentation_shift: create a Shift augmentation module to randomly shift audio waveforms in time by up to a specified number of samples
create_augmentation_flip_channels: create a FlipChannels augmentation module to randomly flip left and right audio channels during training
create_augmentation_flip_sign: create a FlipSign augmentation module to randomly invert the sign of audio waveforms during training
create_augmentation_remix: create a Remix augmentation module to shuffle sources within a batch to generate new audio mixes
create_augmentation_scale: create a Scale augmentation module to randomly scale audio waveforms by a uniform random factor within a specified range
